author: reek
body: The unsound direction of the scope-drop widening, and the reason it is written as a lookup toward an UNSCOPED parameter label rather than as a comparison of two scopes.

author: reek
body: `plain-print` may write to any channel. `apply-scoped` is handed it while believing it holds something that writes only to stdout -- and passes that belief on to its own caller, who granted only `Console "stdout"`. If this compiled, a scope would be a suggestion.

author: reek
body: It must stay refused: nothing ever widens TOWARD a scoped label, because `label-index-named` matches only parameter labels with no scope.
